name: Sygnum FIUSD Liquidity Fund Token
oneLiner: FIUSD is Sygnum's tokenized Fidelity liquidity-fund unit, with NAV-based returns and redemption through a permissioned bank-client account.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: FIUSD is a Swiss ledger-based security representing one Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund USD Class G Acc unit held through Sygnum. It is a money-market fund claim with accumulating NAV and daily fund dealing, not the unrelated Fiserv payment stablecoin. The tbill family models its cash-equivalent fund claim while the underlying government and non-government instruments retain credit and custody risk.

sources.label: Sygnum issuer-authored FIUSD application dated March 20, 2025

collateral: Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund PLC, United States Dollar Fund Class G Acc units held by Sygnum in a fiduciary arrangement. The underlying Irish short-term money-market fund can hold government and non-government money-market instruments, deposits, repos, ABCP and other money-market funds; it is not exclusively Treasury-backed.
pegMechanism: One FIUSD represents one subscribed fund unit at accumulating USD NAV. Sygnum issues after subscription and burns when units are sold or redeemed. Onboarded professional investors use Sygnum-custodied whitelisted wallets; redemption requests trigger burn, a JPMorgan fund sell order and proceeds credited to the bank-client account. Current binding token-level deadlines and same-notional capacity are not publicly established.

proofOfReserves.provider: Deloitte Ireland LLP audited Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund plc's financial statements for the year ended 31 August 2025; its opinion is signed 9 December 2025. This is underlying-fund assurance, not a reconciliation of Sygnum's FIUSD tokens to fiduciary fund units.
